policy: External engines stay outside World_server; the repo contains only adapters/orchestration. This avoids committing large model weights and keeps independent licenses isolated.

engines.name: Depth-Anything-V2
engines.modelPolicy: Default adapter only uses Depth-Anything-V2-Small because upstream states Small is Apache-2.0; Base/Large/Giant are not enabled by this integration.

engines.name: BuildingGeneratorThreeJS
engines.integration: Server-side Blender Geometry Nodes evaluation/export to GLB.

engines.name: bene-proggen-maps
engines.integration: Kept as a separate external Blender add-on and invoked headlessly; its source is not copied into World_server.

engines.name: TRELLIS.2
engines.integration: Lazy-loaded on a persistent Linux NVIDIA GPU worker; model weights are never committed to World_server.
